findings.documented: Every request must carry the API key as a query parameter (?api_key=IVY26-...).
findings.actual: Query parameter returns 401 with 'send your key in the X-API-Key request header, not as a query parameter'.
findings.how_found: Sent GET request to /v1/projects with ?api_key=... in the query string.
findings.impact: All requests following the documented auth pattern fail with 401 Unauthorized.

findings.documented: Response contains 'token', expires_in is 86400 (24 hours), and there is no refresh flow.
findings.actual: Response contains 'access_token', expires_in is 900 (15 minutes), and returns a refresh_token with refresh_url '/auth/refresh'.
findings.how_found: Inspected the JSON payload returned by POST /auth/login.
findings.impact: Client tokens expire after 15 minutes instead of 24 hours, breaking the session unless an active refresh mechanism is implemented.

findings.documented: Implies listings endpoint is accessible with only the API key.
findings.actual: Returns 401 Unauthorized with 'missing bearer token - log in at POST /auth/login first'.
findings.how_found: Sent GET /v1/listings with X-API-Key header but no Authorization header.
findings.impact: Unauthenticated clients cannot browse or fetch property listings without completing the full login flow first.

findings.documented: Every collection endpoint takes page (1-indexed) and limit (default 20, max 200).
findings.actual: Endpoints ignore page and use offset and limit. Default limit is 50, and responses return offset, count, has_more, and total.
findings.how_found: Testing page=2 returned the first page repeatedly, whereas offset=50 returned the subsequent batch.
findings.impact: Clients using page=N loop infinitely or only receive the first page repeatedly.

findings.documented: Money is in Indian rupees, integer, everywhere in the API.
findings.actual: price_min and price_max in /v1/projects are expressed in Crores (float), not integer INR.
findings.how_found: Inspected price_max values across projects; the maximum was 12.44 rather than raw rupees.
findings.impact: Project prices display as trivial amounts (e.g., ₹12.44) unless multiplied by 10^7.

findings.documented: All timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC with a 'Z' suffix.
findings.actual: Timestamps carry an explicit +05:30 offset and an additional 'timezone': 'Asia/Kolkata' field.
findings.how_found: Inspected the raw response of GET /health.
findings.impact: Strict ISO parsers expecting trailing 'Z' fail or compute incorrect time zone offsets.

findings.documented: Singular path GET /v1/listing/{listing_id} returns a single listing.
findings.actual: GET /v1/listing/{id} returns 404; the actual working endpoint is pluralized as /v1/listings/{id}.
findings.how_found: Attempted to query an individual listing using the singular URL path.
findings.impact: Direct listing detail pages fail to load if adhering to the singular route in the documentation.

findings.documented: Inactive, expired and withdrawn listings are excluded server-side, and all records describe valid physical properties.
findings.actual: Endpoint returns inactive listings (is_live: false) as well as physically corrupt listings where floor exceeds total_floors, carpet area exceeds super built-up, or price is negative.
findings.how_found: Audited retrievable records against physical boundary constraints.
findings.impact: Inactive and physically impossible listings are displayed to end users unless sanitized client-side.

findings.documented: total_listings always agrees with what GET /v1/listings?project_id=... returns.
findings.actual: Multiple projects report total_listings numbers that do not match the count of retrievable listings associated with their project_id.
findings.how_found: Cross-referenced project.total_listings against the count of listings bearing matching project_ids.
findings.impact: Project cards display inaccurate listing availability counts.

findings.documented: GET, POST, and DELETE /v1/favourites provide listing bookmarking.
findings.actual: Endpoint /v1/favourites returns 404. The real working endpoint is /v1/saved.
findings.how_found: Probed candidate paths; GET and POST to /v1/saved returned 200 with the active bookmark collection.
findings.impact: All bookmarking operations fail with 404 unless routed to /v1/saved.
